# CANDIDATE: VWAP_MEAN_REVERSION_ENGULF

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extended deviations from VWAP that reverse with an engulfing candle and above-average volume tend to snap back to VWAP, providing a mean-reversion edge. This edge exists because extreme VWAP deviations often reflect temporary order flow imbalances that correct when liquidity returns, especially when confirmed by engulfing candles (showing strong rejection) and volume spikes (indicating participation).

## Mechanism

Compute deviation = (close - VWAP) / ATR(14).  
- **Short entry:** deviation > 0.6 (price above VWAP) AND current bar is bearish engulfing (close < open AND prior bar bullish) AND volume > 1.5× average volume of last 20 bars.  
- **Long entry:** deviation < -0.6 (price below VWAP) AND current bar is bullish engulfing (close > open AND prior bar bearish) AND volume > 1.5× average volume of last 20 bars.  
**Exit:** Stop just beyond the engulfing candle’s extreme (high for short, low for long). Take profit when price crosses VWAP OR reaches 0.8× ATR opposite deviation, whichever comes first.  
**Regime filters:** Only trade when VIX < 20 and time is between 09:45-11:30 ET; avoid during high-impact news or FOMC windows.
